items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: As Max Roach always said, “For every beat I play I owe that old guy five.”

ctx.x: I mean I’ve never seen anything like that before. Every drummer — it couldn’t have been no one playing drums nowhere that day, that evening. I’ve never seen that many — I’ve been at a lot of those affairs, those funerals like that, you know, and I’ve never seen nothing like that before in my life. Never. He had touched so many people. I can’t think of no drummer that ever saw him play — if you’ve got any kind of brain you had to get something. Because he just had so much. He just threw away so much stuff. I’m…
trying to get some of it you know. As Max Roach always said, “For every beat I play I owe that old guy five.”
Wow. And the sound of the Basie rhythm section.
